FineVLA: Fine-Grained Instruction Alignment for Steerable Vision-Language-Action Policies VLA

fine-grained instruction steerable policy vision-language-action policy learning robot manipulation

简要说明：FineVLA 提出了一个框架，用细粒度、人工验证的动作指令丰富机器人轨迹数据集，使 VLA 策略既可操控又能保持高层次任务的成功率。

TLDR: FineVLA introduces a framework for augmenting robot trajectory datasets with fine-grained, human-verified action instructions, enabling VLA policies that are both steerable and maintain high goal-level task success.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly expected to not only complete robot tasks, but also follow human instructions about how those tasks should be executed. However, existing robot datasets usually pair trajectories with coarse goal-level language, leaving execution-critical details such as active arm, approach direction, and contact region unspecified. This limits steerable policy learning and robotic video understanding. We introduce FineVLA, an open framework for action-aligned fine-grained VLA supervision. The framework includes: (1) a data construction tool that unifies 972,247 trajectories across 85K tasks from 10 open-source robot datasets and builds FineVLA-Data, a human-verified dataset of 47,159 fine-grained trajectories; (2) a held-out benchmark with 500 videos, 10,816 atomic facts, and 1,030 VQA questions; (3) a robotics-specialized VLM annotator for scalable fine-grained annotation; and (4) a steerable VLA policy trained with controlled mixtures of fine-grained and raw goal-level instructions. Our experiments yield three findings. First, fine-grained supervision does not sacrifice goal-level success: FG-only improves over Raw-only by +1.4 to +8.1 success-rate points across settings. Second, fine-grained and raw instructions are complementary, following a consistent inverted-U trend peaking at FG:Raw = 1:2 to 1:1. The best mixed setting reaches 86.8%/82.5% in RoboTwin simulation and 62.7/100 in real-world dual-arm manipulation (vs. 49.9 Raw-only). Third, fine-grained supervision improves steerable control: the largest real-world gains appear on pose (+23), color (+18), and approach direction (+18)--factors where goal-level instructions provide no guidance. Overall, fine-grained language should augment goal-level instructions: specifying how to execute alongside what to achieve. Project page: https://finevla.xlang.ai/

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型日益被期望不仅能完成机器人任务，还能遵循人类关于如何执行这些任务的指令。然而，现有的机器人数据集通常将轨迹与粗粒度的目标级语言配对，忽略了诸如活动手臂、接近方向和接触区域等执行关键细节，这限制了可引导策略学习与机器人视频理解。为此，我们提出FineVLA——一个面向动作对齐的细粒度VLA监督的开放框架。该框架包括：(1) 一个数据构建工具，统一了来自10个开源机器人数据集的972,247条轨迹（涵盖85K个任务），并构建了人类验证的细粒度数据集FineVLA-Data（包含47,159条细粒度轨迹）；(2) 一个保留测试基准，包含500个视频、10,816个原子事实和1,030个视觉问答问题；(3) 一个面向机器人领域的专用视觉语言模型标注器，用于可扩展的细粒度标注；(4) 一个可引导的VLA策略，通过细粒度与原始目标级指令的受控混合进行训练。我们的实验得出三项发现：第一，细粒度监督不会牺牲目标级成功率——在不同设置下，仅使用细粒度指令相比仅使用原始指令，成功率提高了1.4至8.1个百分点。第二，细粒度与原始指令具有互补性，遵循一致的倒U型趋势，在细粒度与原始指令比例为1:2至1:1时达到峰值。最优混合设置在RoboTwin仿真中达到86.8%/82.5%的成功率，在真实世界双臂操作中达到62.7/100（而仅用原始指令为49.9）。第三，细粒度监督提升了可引导控制能力：真实世界中的最大增益出现在姿态（+23）、颜色（+18）和接近方向（+18）上——这些正是目标级指令未提供引导的因素。总体而言，细粒度语言应作为目标级指令的补充：在明确“做什么”的同时，说明“如何执行”。项目页面：https://finevla.xlang.ai/

Authors: Xintong Hu, Xuhong Huang, Jinyu Zhang, Yutong Yao, Yuchong Sun, Qiuyue Wang, Mingsheng Li, Sicheng Xie, Yitao Liu, Junhao Chen, Yixuan Chen, Yingming Zheng, Shuai Bai, Tao Yu

GE-Sim 2.0: A Roadmap Towards Comprehensive Closed-loop Video World Simulators for Robotic Manipulation WorldModel

closed-loop video world simulator action-conditioned video generation robotic manipulation VLA policy world judge

简要说明：GE-Sim 2.0 是一个用于机器人操作的闭环视频世界模拟器，通过动作条件视频生成、用于VLA策略的状态解码、自动成功检测的评判模块以及快速推理框架，支持可扩展的评估和策略学习。

TLDR: GE-Sim 2.0 is a closed-loop video world simulator for robotic manipulation that uses action-conditioned video generation, a state expert for VLA policy support, a world judge for automatic success detection, and an acceleration framework for fast rollout, enabling scalable evaluation and policy learning.

Abstract: We introduce GE-Sim 2.0 (Genie Envisioner World Simulator 2.0), a closed-loop video world simulator for robotic manipulation. Building on the action-conditioned video generation framework of Genie Envisioner, GE-Sim 2.0 is re-trained on thousands of hours of real-world robot data spanning teleoperation, contact-rich interaction, and on-robot policy deployment, substantially improving action-following fidelity and trajectory coverage. On top of this foundation, three new modules close the loop from video simulation to policy learning: a state expert that decodes proprioceptive state from video latents to support next-chunk prediction by downstream VLA policies; a world judge that scores generated rollouts against task instructions, yielding machine-verifiable success signals and rewards in place of manual inspection; and an acceleration framework that delivers a 25-frame rollout in 2.3 seconds on a single H100, with up to 4* frame skipping at inference for long-horizon evaluation. GE-Sim 2.0 tops the public WorldArena leaderboard at only 2B parameters, outperforming both dedicated robotic world models and closed-source general video generators, and policies trained against its rollouts and rewards translate into measurable real-world gains, establishing GE-Sim 2.0 as a practical platform for scalable evaluation and closed-loop learning of manipulation policies.

摘要（中文）：我们推出GE-Sim 2.0（Genie Envisioner世界模拟器2.0），这是一个用于机器人操作的闭环视频世界模拟器。基于Genie Envisioner的动作条件视频生成框架，GE-Sim 2.0在数千小时的现实机器人数据上重新训练，涵盖遥操作、接触式交互以及机器人策略部署，显著提升了动作跟随精度与轨迹覆盖率。在此基础之上，三个新模块打通了从视频模拟到策略学习的闭环：状态专家模块从视频潜在表示中解码本体感觉状态，以支持下游VLA策略的下一分块预测；世界裁判模块根据任务指令对生成的轨迹进行评分，提供机器可验证的成功信号与奖励，替代人工检查；加速框架在单个H100上仅需2.3秒即可完成25帧的轨迹生成，并在推理时支持最高4倍跳帧以实现长程评估。GE-Sim 2.0仅以2B参数便登顶公开的WorldArena排行榜，超越了专属机器人世界模型与闭源通用视频生成器，且基于其模拟轨迹与奖励训练的策略在真实机器人上取得了可量化的性能提升，这确立了GE-Sim 2.0作为可扩展评估与机器人策略闭环学习的实用平台地位。

VR-DAgger: Immersive VR for Dexterous Data Collection and Uncertainty-Guided On-Policy Correction Manipulation

VR data collection uncertainty-guided correction dexterous manipulation on-policy learning

简要说明：VR-DAgger 利用沉浸式虚拟现实进行灵巧数据收集和不确定性引导的在策略纠正，以改善分布偏移下的机器人操作。

TLDR: VR-DAgger uses immersive VR for dexterous data collection and uncertainty-guided on-policy correction to improve robotic manipulation under distribution shift.

Abstract: Learning from demonstrations is effective for robotic manipulation, but collecting sufficient task-specific data remains a major bottleneck. Under distribution shift, small errors compound, performance degrades, and expert time is often spent on redundant, low-value corrections instead of the few critical failure cases.

摘要（中文）：从示范中学习对机器人操作而言是有效的，但收集足够的特定任务数据仍是一个主要瓶颈。在分布偏移下，小误差会累积叠加，性能逐渐下降，而专家的时间往往耗费在冗余且低价值的修正上，而非专注于少数关键性失败案例。

Authors: René Zurbrügg, Tifanny Portela, Arjun Bhardwaj, Aravind Elanjimattathil Vijayan, Maximum Wilder-Smith, Marco Hutter

TPS-Drive: Task-Guided Representation Purification for VLM-based Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

task-guided representation purification agent-centric tokenizer vector quantization VLM-based planning closed-loop driving

简要说明：TPS-Drive 提出任务导向表示纯化方法，将空间信息压缩为离散标记，消除背景冗余和空间幻觉，使 VLM 能够执行场景理解、预测和动作生成以实现自动驾驶。

TLDR: TPS-Drive introduces Task-Guided Representation Purification to compress spatial information into discrete tokens that eliminate background redundancy and spatial hallucination, enabling VLMs to perform scene understanding, forecasting, and action generation for autonomous driving.

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide a promising foundation for autonomous driving planning, yet bridging semantic reasoning and precise 3D spatial forecasting remains a critical challenge. Existing representation strategies generally follow two paths: text-aligned methods flatten continuous spatial states into symbols, which compromises geometric structure and induces "spatial hallucinations"; dense visual methods preserve spatial topology but overwhelm standard tokenizers with redundant background textures, leading to "representation interference". To address these limitations, we introduce TPS-Drive, a novel framework centered on Task-Guided Representation Purification that empowers VLMs to Think in Purified Space. At its core, an Agent-Centric Tokenizer utilizes a task-guided vector quantization mechanism supervised by a frozen 3D detection head, which explicitly reallocates limited codebook capacity from pervasive static backgrounds to critical dynamic agents and effectively isolates spatial redundancy. Leveraging this purified spatial vocabulary, TPS-Drive employs a decoupled reasoning pipeline that sequentially performs scene understanding, future forecasting, and action generation. The framework is optimized via a progressive three-stage training paradigm, culminating in reward-driven refinement that surpasses pure imitation learning. Extensive experiments validate our approach: TPS-Drive achieves accurate agent spatial state forecasting and reduces collision rates in open-loop nuScenes evaluations, while establishing new safety records on the rigorous closed-loop NAVSIMv1 and NAVSIMv2 benchmarks.

摘要（中文）：视觉语言模型（VLMs）为自动驾驶规划提供了极具前景的基础，但如何弥合语义推理与精确三维空间预测之间的鸿沟仍是关键挑战。现有表示策略通常遵循两条路径：文本对齐方法将连续空间状态压缩为符号，这破坏了几何结构并引发"空间幻觉"；密集视觉方法虽能保留空间拓扑，但冗余背景纹理会淹没标准分词器，导致"表示干扰"。针对这些局限，我们提出TPS-Drive——一种以任务引导表示纯化为核心的新型框架，使VLM能够在纯化空间中进行思考。其核心创新在于基于智能体引导的分词器，该分词器通过冻结的三维检测头监督下的任务引导式向量量化机制，将有限的码本容量从普遍存在的静态背景显式重新分配至关键动态智能体，并有效隔离空间冗余性。借助这种纯化的空间词汇，TPS-Drive采用解耦推理管线，依次执行场景理解、未来预测和动作生成。该框架通过渐进式三阶段训练范式进行优化，最终通过奖励驱动式精炼超越了纯模仿学习。大量实验验证了本方法的有效性：TPS-Drive在开环nuScenes评估中实现了精确的智能体空间状态预测并降低了碰撞率，同时在严格闭环的NAVSIMv1和NAVSIMv2基准测试中创下了新的安全记录。

Authors: Jiaxiang Li, Yumao Liu, Ke Ma

Towards Shared Embodied Intelligence in Humanoid Robots through Optimization Development and Testing of the Human Aware ergoCub Robot HumanoidEmbodied

shared embodied intelligence ergonomic optimization humanoid robot physical intelligence human-robot collaboration

简要说明：本文提出了一种将共享智能与具身认知相结合的人形机器人架构，通过优化硬件和控制以适应人体工效学指标，并以ergoCub机器人为具体实现。

TLDR: This paper presents an architecture that integrates shared intelligence and embodied cognition for humanoid robots, optimizing hardware and control for human ergonomic metrics, demonstrated by the ergoCub robot.

Abstract: Collaboration is central to human behavior, enabling tasks beyond individual capability. This ability arises from coordinating actions through internal representations of others, a concept known as shared intelligence. Additionally, humans are characterized by physical bodies and cognitive abilities that are optimized in response to their environment, a phenomenon referred to as embodied cognition. Designing humanoid robots that collaborate safely and effectively with people requires unifying these principles. Here we propose an architecture that integrates shared intelligence and embodied cognition to enable robots to physically collaborate with humans, where robot hardware and control are optimized for human metrics, using representations of the human body and motion intelligence. The ultimate goal is to achieve a form of shared embodied intelligence. Specifically, our architecture optimizes robot hardware and physical intelligence parameters with respect to human ergonomic metrics. This is accomplished by modeling human-robot interaction as a function of hardware configurations and embedding human models into the robot's physical intelligence. As a concrete implementation, we present the humanoid robot ergoCub, whose morphology and control have been optimized for collaborative tasks with humans. Our approach provides a framework for designing humanoid robots that prioritize human ergonomics at both the hardware and physical intelligence levels, with applications in industrial and assistive robotics.

摘要（中文）：协作是人类行为的核心，使个体无法独立完成的任务成为可能。这种能力源于通过对他人的内在表征来协调行动，这一概念被称为共享智能。此外，人类拥有优化适应环境的身体与认知能力，这一现象称为具身认知。设计能够与人安全有效协作的仿人机器人需要统一这些原理。本文提出一种集成共享智能与具身认知的架构，使机器人能够与人类进行物理协作，其中机器人硬件与控制针对人体指标进行优化，并利用人体表征与运动智能。其终极目标是实现一种共享具身智能的形式。具体而言，我们的架构基于人体工效学指标优化机器人硬件与物理智能参数。这是通过将人机交互建模为硬件配置的函数，并将人体模型嵌入机器人物理智能来实现的。作为具体实现，我们展示了仿人机器人ergoCub，其形态与控制已针对人类协作任务进行优化。本方法为设计在硬件与物理智能层面优先考虑人体工效学的仿人机器人提供了框架，可应用于工业与辅助机器人领域。

Authors: Carlotta Sartore, Mohamed Elobaid, Lorenzo Rapetti, Giulio Romualdi, Stefano Dafarra, Nicola A. Piga, Ines Sorrentino, Paolo Maria Vicecone, Silvio Traversaro, Ugo Pattacini, Luca Fiorio, Francesco Draicchio, Giovanna Tranfo, Lorenzo Natale, Marco Maggiali, Daniele Pucci

Object Pose and Shape Estimation for Grasping: Does it Work? Manipulation

object pose estimation shape estimation grasping antipodal grasp sampling vision-language models

简要说明：本文评估了模块化的物体姿态和形状估计方法结合对极抓取采样是否优于端到端抓取合成方法，发现模块化方法表现更好但在杂乱场景中性能下降，并展示了单视图姿态/形状估计可与VLM结合实现语言条件抓取。

TLDR: This paper evaluates whether modular object pose and shape estimation methods, combined with antipodal grasp sampling, outperform end-to-end grasp synthesis for parallel-jaw grippers, and finds that modular methods perform better but degrade in cluttered scenes. It also shows that single-view pose/shape estimation can be augmented with VLMs for language-conditioned grasping.

Abstract: The problem of object pose and shape estimation has seen key advancements lately. Encoder-decoder (e.g., SAM3D, LRM, CRISP) and diffusion-based models (e.g., InstantMesh, Zero123, SceneComplete) have shown category-agnostic shape encoding capacity and open-set generalizability. In this work, we ask the question: Are the object pose and shape estimation methods mature enough, such that when used with antipodal grasp sampling, can outperform the end-to-end grasp synthesis methods? We explore this question in detail by scoping our study to parallel jaw grippers, 7-DoF grasps, and single-view RGB(-D) image as input. We implement and compare a state-of-the-art, end-to-end grasp synthesis method and three modular methods, which first estimate the object pose and shape for all objects in the scene, and generate grasps using antipodal sampling. We observe that the modular methods outperform the end-to-end method in all our experiments. The modular methods are able to synthesize plenty of grasps, even for small objects, where the end-to-end methods fail. The effectiveness of the modular methods is contingent on the accuracy of the pose and shape estimation, and suffers partial degradation in cluttered scenes - a limitation of the existing pose and shape estimation methods. We also analyze the failure modes and run-times for the three modular methods, which use two different ways of object pose and shape estimation: one based on an encoder-decoder model, while another a diffusion model. Finally, we demonstrate that the single-view object pose and shape estimation methods can be augmented with vision-language models to yield language-conditioned grasps from just single-view RGB-D image as input. We notice comparable performance to the state-of-the-art LERF-TOGO baseline.

摘要（中文）：物体姿态与形状估计问题近期取得了关键性进展。编码器-解码器模型（如SAM3D、LRM、CRISP）与基于扩散的模型（如InstantMesh、Zero123、SceneComplete）展现了类别无关的形状编码能力及开放集泛化性。本研究提出疑问：当物体姿态与形状估计方法与对极抓取采样结合使用时，其成熟度是否足以超越端到端抓取合成方法？我们将研究范围限定于平行爪夹持器、七自由度抓取及单视角RGB(-D)图像输入，通过详细实验探讨该问题。我们实现并对比了一种先进端到端抓取合成方法与三种模块化方法——后者先估计场景中所有物体的姿态与形状，再通过极线采样生成抓取姿态。实验表明，所有测试中模块化方法均优于端到端方法。模块化方法能够合成大量抓取姿态，即使针对端到端方法失效的小物体亦如此。其有效性取决于姿态与形状估计的精度，在杂乱场景中会出现部分性能退化——这反映了现有姿态与形状估计方法的局限性。我们还分析了三种模块化方法的失效模式与运行时间，这些方法采用两种不同的物体姿态与形状估计方式：一种基于编码器-解码器模型，另一种基于扩散模型。最后，我们证明单视角物体姿态与形状估计方法可结合视觉语言模型，仅需单视角RGB-D图像输入即可生成语言条件约束的抓取姿态，其性能与先进基线LERF-TOGO相当。

Authors: Pavan Karke, Kushal Shah, Gaurav Singh, Md Faizal Karim, K Madhava Krishna, Rajat Talak

Can VLA Models Learn from Real-World Data Continually without Forgetting? VLA

continual learning catastrophic forgetting experience replay real-world manipulation VLA models

简要说明：本文首次在真实机器人操作任务上对VLA模型的持续学习进行实证研究，发现其存在严重的灾难性遗忘问题，并通过经验回放及关键实现因素得到缓解。

TLDR: This paper presents the first empirical study of continual learning for VLA models on real-world robotic manipulation tasks, showing that they suffer catastrophic forgetting which can be mitigated by experience replay with careful implementation.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide a promising foundation for general-purpose robotics. However, their successful deployment in real-world scenarios requires the ability to continually acquire new skills while retaining previously learned behaviors. While pioneering research has studied the continual learning of VLA models in narrowly simulated environments, this challenge remains largely unexplored under realistic conditions. To address this limitation, we construct a real-world continual learning dataset comprising four sequential manipulation tasks, spanning rigid-object pick-and-place, contact-rich pressing, and deformable-object folding. Using this dataset, we conduct comprehensive experiments and find that VLA models suffer significant catastrophic forgetting when continually learning from heterogeneous real-world demonstrations. We then systematically evaluate experience replay and uncover key implementation factors that govern its success. In summary, this work provides the first empirical study of real-world continual VLA learning and offers practical guidance for deploying long-lived robot policies.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为通用机器人技术提供了富有前景的基础。然而，其在真实场景中的成功部署需要具备持续获取新技能同时保留已学行为的能力。尽管已有开创性研究在受限的模拟环境中探索了VLA模型的持续学习问题，但在现实条件下该挑战仍鲜有涉及。为弥补这一不足，我们构建了一个真实世界的持续学习数据集，包含四项顺序操作任务，涵盖刚体抓取放置、接触密集型按压以及可变形物体折叠。利用该数据集，我们开展了全面实验，发现VLA模型在从异构真实世界演示中持续学习时会出现显著的灾难性遗忘。随后，我们系统评估了经验回放机制，并揭示了决定其成功的关键实施因素。总之，本工作首次对真实世界中的持续VLA学习进行了实证研究，并为部署长期运行的机器人策略提供了实践指导。

Authors: Jiarun Zhu, Yijun Hong, Xiaoquan Sun, Zetian Xu, Mingqi Yuan, Zhiyong Wang, Wenjun Zeng, Jiayu Chen

HyperSim: A Holistic Sim-To-Real Framework For Robust Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

sim-to-real manipulation adversarial trajectory generation domain-invariant representations robustness

简要说明：HyperSim 提出了一套全面的仿真到现实框架，通过高保真环境合成、对抗轨迹生成和仿真与真实联合训练，在 ACT 和 π0 策略上实现了高真实世界任务成功率。

TLDR: HyperSim presents a holistic sim-to-real framework for robotic manipulation that combines high-fidelity environment synthesis, adversarial trajectory generation, and sim-and-real co-training, achieving high success rates on real-world tasks with ACT and π0 policies.

Abstract: Scaling data volume and diversity is critical for generalizing embodied intelligence. While synthetic data generation offers a scalable alternative to expensive physical data acquisition, transferring robotic manipulation policies from simulation to the real world (sim-to-real) remains a formidable challenge due to the domain gap. This paper presents HyperSim, a holistic framework spanning from synthetic data generation to policy training and seamless real-world deployment. To systematically bridge the sim-to-real gap, HyperSim is realized through three core pillars: high-fidelity environment synthesis, adversarial trajectory generation, and sim-and-real co-training. Collectively, these modules address domain discrepancies by enhancing visual fidelity, expanding data coverage, and enforcing domain-invariant representations. We rigorously validate HyperSim through a large-scale empirical study involving 400 real-world task executions across two representative manipulation models. Assessed across three fine-grained metrics, our complete pipeline achieves remarkable sim-to-real success rates of 80% and 95% with ACT and π_{0}, respectively. Furthermore, policies trained on our adversarial trajectories exhibit significantly enhanced robustness against dynamic uncertainties, achieving a 35% higher completion rate under physical perturbations.

摘要（中文）：扩展数据规模与多样性对于实现具身智能的泛化能力至关重要。尽管合成数据生成为昂贵的物理数据采集提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但由于领域差异的存在，将机器人操作策略从仿真迁移到现实世界（仿真-现实迁移）仍是一项严峻挑战。本文提出HyperSim，这是一个涵盖从合成数据生成到策略训练及无缝现实部署的整体框架。为了系统性地弥合仿真-现实差距，HyperSim通过三大核心支柱实现：高保真环境合成、对抗性轨迹生成以及仿真-现实联合训练。这些模块协同作用，通过提升视觉保真度、扩展数据覆盖范围并强化领域不变表征来应对领域差异。我们通过一项大规模实证研究严格验证了HyperSim，该研究涉及两种代表性操作模型在400项现实世界任务执行中的表现。基于三个细粒度指标的评估表明，采用ACT和π_{0}时，我们的完整流水线分别实现了80%和95%的显著仿真-现实迁移成功率。此外，基于对抗性轨迹训练的策略在动态不确定性下展现出显著增强的鲁棒性，在物理扰动条件下的任务完成率提升了35%。

Authors: Junyi Dong, Haotian Luo, Ziwei Xu, Shengwei Bian, Heng Zhang, Sitong Mao, Jingyi Guo, Yang Xu, Wenhao Chen, Qiuyu Feng, Yao Mu, Ping Luo, Shunbo Zhou, Xiaodong Wu

Enabling Extensible Embodied Capabilities with Tools VLA

capability externalization embodied tool protocol tool-augmented policy EmbodiedToolBench embodied core competence

简要说明：本文提出具身工具协议（ETP）和具身工具基准（EmbodiedToolBench），将异构能力解耦为独立工具，在仿真和真实任务中提升具身性能31%-36%。

TLDR: This paper introduces Embodied Tool Protocol (ETP) and EmbodiedToolBench to externalize heterogeneous capabilities into separate tools, improving embodied performance by 31-36% on simulation and real-world tasks.

Abstract: Most existing embodied intelligence methods formulate perception, reasoning, planning, and control within a unified parameterized policy. Yet these capabilities are inherently hierarchical and heterogeneous, making them difficult to reliably learn and modularize within a single model. We propose a capability externalization approach that decouples heterogeneous capabilities into independently optimized tools, dynamically invoked at inference time. To this end, we introduce Embodied Tool Protocol (ETP), a standardized protocol for embodied tool registration, discovery, invocation, and execution, and curate 100+ validated tools spanning perception, cognition, reasoning, and execution as the tool base. Building on this, we construct EmbodiedToolBench to evaluate both whether tool augmentation improves embodied performance and how well current models use tools across tool-necessity recognition, tool selection, tool execution, and tool-chain composition. Experiments across simulation and real-world platforms confirm that capability externalization consistently improves embodied performance (avg. gain 31% on EB-ALFRED and 36% on EB-Navigation), yet reveal a clear boundary: gains are substantial for cognition and perception but are limited for execution-type capabilities. Moreover, our analysis reveals that knowing when, which, and how to invoke tools remains a persistent challenge across all models, thereby highlighting embodied tool competence as a critical direction for future research.

摘要（中文）：现有的具身智能方法大多将感知、推理、规划与控制整合在统一的参数化策略中。然而，这些能力本质上具有层次化和异质性的特点，难以在单一模型中可靠学习并实现模块化。我们提出一种能力外化方法，将异质能力解耦为独立优化的工具，并在推理时动态调用。为此，我们引入具身工具协议（ETP），这是一种用于具身工具注册、发现、调用与执行的标准化协议，并整理了涵盖感知、认知、推理与执行等领域的100余个经过验证的工具作为工具库。在此基础上，我们构建了具身工具基准（EmbodiedToolBench），用于评估工具增强对具身性能的提升效果，以及当前模型在工具需求识别、工具选择、工具执行与工具链组合方面的工具使用能力。在仿真与真实世界平台上的实验一致表明，能力外化能够持续提升具身性能（在EB-ALFRED和EB-Navigation上平均提升31%和36%），但同时也揭示了明显的边界：在认知与感知能力上的提升显著，而在执行类能力上的提升有限。此外，我们的分析表明，所有模型在何时调用、调用哪个工具以及如何调用工具方面仍面临持续挑战，这凸显出具身工具能力作为未来研究的关键方向。

Authors: Xueyang Zhou, Zijia Wang, Qianjiang Li, Yibo Hu, Guiyao Tie, Li Wan, Yidan Liu, Pan Zhou, Lichao Sun, Yongchao Chen

A Factory-Floor Deployment Case Study of VLA Pipelines for Industrial Packaging Task: Workflow, Failures, and Lessons VLA

VLA pipelines industrial packaging factory-floor deployment failure modes iterative fine-tuning

简要说明：本文报告了在西门子工厂部署预训练的Pi0.5 VLA策略执行工业包装任务的案例研究，记录了2535轮数据、反复出现的故障模式以及实际部署经验。

TLDR: This paper presents a case study of deploying a pretrained Pi0.5 VLA policy for an industrial packaging task at a Siemens factory, documenting 2535 episodes of data, recurring failure modes, and practical deployment lessons.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have shown promising manipulation capabilities, yet their practical impact is often limited by the reliability demands of real-world deployment. We present a deployment study of an industrial packaging task at Siemens Factory (GWE, Erlangen, Germany), where a robot must pick a transparent accessory bag from a cluttered pile, insert it into the remaining cavity of a cardboard package, and ensure that the bag and its contents remain below the closing plane. Our goal is to understand the practical effort required to adapt a pretrained Pi0.5 policy to a single factory-floor task through iterative fine-tuning and deployment-driven refinement. The pipeline consists of repeated loops of data collection, curation, fine-tuning, evaluation, and targeted recovery data collection. We have accumulated 2535 episodes (10 hours) from the on-site factory settings. In this paper, we contribute an empirical account of a factory-floor VLA deployment, highlighting recurring failure modes and lessons that inform how to improve the deployment workflow.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-行动策略展现出令人瞩目的操作能力，但其实际影响力常受限于现实部署中的可靠性要求。本文报告了西门子工厂（德国埃朗根GWE）一项工业包装任务的部署研究：机器人需从杂乱的堆叠中拾取透明配件袋，将其插入纸箱的剩余空腔中，并确保袋子及其内容物保持在封合平面以下。我们的目标在于理解通过迭代微调与部署驱动优化，将预训练Pi0.5策略适配至单一工厂车间任务所需付出的实际努力。该流程包含数据采集、数据筛选、微调、评估以及定向恢复数据采集的循环重复。我们已从现场工厂环境中累计获取2535个任务片段（10小时）。本文对工厂车间级VLA部署进行了实证阐述，重点分析了反复出现的故障模式及经验教训，为改进部署工作流提供参考。

Authors: Brian Zhu, Philipp Schmitt, Philine Meister, Lukas Gensler, Momen Khalil, Emmanuele Poggi, Johannes Hechtl, Carsten Braunroth, Kai Wurm, Gokul Narayanan, Eugen Solowjow, Georg von Wichert, Andre Scholz, Felix Albrecht, Maxmillian Metzner

Personalizing Embodied Multimodal Large Language Model Agents over Long-term User Interactions Other

multimodal memory personalized embodied agents knowledge graph long-term user interactions MLLM

简要说明：POLAR 提出了一种基于多模态记忆增强的框架，利用知识图谱实现能够通过长期用户交互进行个性化任务执行的具身智能体。

TLDR: POLAR proposes a multimodal memory-augmented framework with a knowledge graph to enable personalized embodied agents that leverage long-term user interactions for task execution.

Abstract: Multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based embodied agents have shown strong potential for solving complex tasks in physical environments. However, personalized assistance requires more than following generic instruction or recognizing object categories. In real-world scenarios, the intended target is often specified only implicitly through prior interactions, requiring agents to leverage personalized context accumulated over time. In this work, we propose POLAR, a multiomodal memory-augmented framework for personalized embodied agents over long-term user interactions. POLAR organizes prior interactions into a multimodal knowledge graph that captures semantic memory for personalized context and visual concepts, and episodic memory for embodied experiences such as agent trajectories. To execute embodied tasks, POLAR retrieves relevant memories to interpret the current request and guide task execution. We evaluate POLAR across multiple MLLM backbones and diverse evaluation scenarios to study the role of memory in long-term personalization. Results show that the proposed memory mechanism consistently improves performance by enabling more effective use of information accumulated over prior interactions. The gains are especially pronounced when the agents are required to reason across multiple interactions, perform multi-hop inference, or tracking updates in user-specific context over time.

摘要（中文）：基于多模态大语言模型的具身智能体在物理环境中解决复杂任务方面展现出强大潜力。然而，个性化辅助不仅需要遵循通用指令或识别物体类别。在真实场景中，目标对象往往仅通过先前的交互被隐含指定，要求智能体利用随时间积累的个性化情境。本文提出POLAR——一种面向长期用户交互的多模态记忆增强框架，用于构建个性化具身智能体。POLAR将先前的交互组织成多模态知识图谱，其中包含用于个性化情境和视觉概念的语义记忆，以及用于具身体验（如智能体轨迹）的情景记忆。为执行具身任务，POLAR会检索相关记忆以解释当前请求并指导任务执行。我们在多种多模态大语言模型骨干网络和多样化评估场景下对POLAR进行评测，以研究记忆在长期个性化中的作用。结果表明，所提出的记忆机制通过更有效地利用先前交互中积累的信息，持续提升了任务表现。当智能体需要跨多个交互进行推理、执行多跳推理或随时间追踪用户特定情境的更新时，性能提升尤为显著。

Authors: Jeongeun Lee, Chanyoung Park, Dongha Lee

3D Gaussian Map with Open-Set Semantic Grouping for Vision-Language Navigation VLN

3D Gaussian Map Open-Set Semantic Grouping Vision-Language Navigation Egocentric Scene Map Multi-Level Action Prediction

简要说明：提出了一种带有开放集语义分组的三维高斯地图用于视觉语言导航，使智能体能够在线构建统一的场景表示，并利用多层级动作预测来遵循自然语言指令。

TLDR: A 3D Gaussian map with open-set semantic grouping is proposed for vision-language navigation, enabling the agent to build a unified scene representation online and use multi-level action prediction to follow natural language instructions.

Abstract: Vision-language navigation (VLN) requires an agent to traverse complex 3D environments based on natural language instructions, necessitating a thorough scene understanding. While existing works equip agents with various scene representations to enhance spatial awareness, they often neglect the complex 3D geometry and rich semantics in VLN scenarios, limiting the ability to generalize across diverse and unseen environments. To address these challenges, this work proposes a 3D Gaussian Map that represents the environment as a set of differentiable 3D Gaussians and accordingly develops a navigation strategy for VLN. Specifically, Egocentric Scene Map is constructed online by initializing 3D Gaussians from sparse pseudo-lidar point clouds, providing informative geometric priors for scene understanding. Each Gaussian primitive is further enriched through Open-Set Semantic Grouping operation, which groups 3D Gaussians based on their membership in object instances or stuff categories within the open world, resulting in a unified 3D Gaussian Map. Building on this map, Multi-Level Action Prediction strategy, which combines spatial-semantic cues at multiple granularities, is designed to assist agents in decision-making. Extensive experiments conducted on three public benchmarks (i.e., R2R, R4R, and REVERIE) validate the effectiveness of our method.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言导航（VLN）要求智能体基于自然语言指令在复杂三维环境中穿行，这需要具备彻底的场景理解能力。现有研究虽然为智能体配备了多种场景表征以增强空间感知，但往往忽视了VLN场景中复杂的三维几何结构与丰富的语义信息，限制了其在多样且未知环境中的泛化能力。针对这些挑战，本文提出一种三维高斯地图，将环境表示为一组可微分的三维高斯体，并据此开发了面向VLN的导航策略。具体而言，通过从稀疏伪激光雷达点云初始化三维高斯体，在线构建自我中心场景地图，为场景理解提供丰富的几何先验。进一步，通过开放集语义分组操作，依据三维高斯体在开放世界中属于物体实例或材质类别的隶属关系对其进行分组，从而丰富每个高斯基元的语义信息，形成统一的三维高斯地图。基于该地图，设计了多粒度空间-语义线索融合的多级动作预测策略，以辅助智能体进行决策。在三个公开基准（即R2R、R4R和REVERIE）上开展的大量实验验证了本方法的有效性。

Authors: Jianzhe Gao, Rui Liu, Wenguan Wang

Scaling World-Model Reinforcement Learning Through Diffusion Policy Optimization WorldModel

world model diffusion policy reinforcement learning policy optimization model-based RL

简要说明：本文发现基于世界模型的强化学习中搜索与价值学习之间的结构性错位，并提出通过扩散策略优化统一两者的MBDPO框架，实现了随模型容量增长的一致性性能提升。

TLDR: This paper identifies a structural misalignment between search and value learning in world-model-based RL, and proposes MBDPO to unify them via diffusion policy optimization, achieving consistent scaling with model capacity.

Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (RL) can be effectively supported at scale through the use of world models. However, in practice, scaling such approaches remains fundamentally limited. A commonly recognized challenge is model bias and error compounding, which degrade long-horizon predictions. Beyond these issues, we identify a more critical yet underexplored bottleneck: a structural misalignment between search and value learning in existing world model approaches. In particular, policy improvement often relies on value functions induced by a separate, non-search policy, resulting in training inconsistency and ultimately suboptimal learning. To address this limitation, we propose Model-Based Diffusion Policy Optimization (MBDPO) in world models, a framework that unifies search and policy optimization through diffusion policy representations, thereby unlocking the potential of world models for scalable policy learning. Instead of constructing an explicit planner over a learned world model, we reformulate policy optimization as a diffusion process over searched trajectories in latent world models. In this view, we extract an implicit energy function from the collected dataset that anchors the policy, enabling MBDPO to refine the score field for policy optimization while mitigating misalignment. We evaluate MBDPO across a wide range of settings, including multi-task offline pretraining, online learning, and offline-to-online fine-tuning. In the offline regime, we further investigate its scaling behavior by pretraining on large-scale datasets, observing consistent and monotonic performance gains with increasing model capacity.

摘要（中文）：基于模型强化学习可通过使用世界模型实现规模化有效支撑。然而在实践中，此类方法的扩展仍面临根本性限制。模型偏差与误差累积是公认的挑战，会导致长时域预测性能下降。除这些问题外，我们识别出一个更为关键且尚未充分探究的瓶颈：现有世界模型方法中搜索与价值学习之间的结构性错配。具体而言，策略改进通常依赖由独立非搜索策略生成的价值函数，导致训练不一致性并最终产生次优学习效果。为解决这一局限，我们提出基于模型的世界模型扩散策略优化（MBDPO）框架——通过扩散策略表示统一搜索与策略优化，从而释放世界模型在可扩展策略学习中的潜力。该框架不在学习到的世界模型上构建显式规划器，而是将策略优化重构为潜在世界模型中搜索轨迹上的扩散过程。基于此视角，我们从收集的数据集中提取隐式能量函数锚定策略，使MBDPO能够优化策略更新的评分场同时缓解错配问题。我们在多任务离线预训练、在线学习及离线到在线微调等广泛场景中评估MBDPO。在离线设置下，我们进一步通过大规模数据集预训练研究其扩展特性，观察到随模型容量增加而持续单调的性能提升。

Authors: Xiaoyuan Cheng, Wenxuan Yuan, Zhancun Mu, Yuanzhao Zhang, Yiming Yang, Hai Wang, Zhuo Sun, Che Liu

Riding the Shifting Potential: When Reactive Control Suffices for Multi-Goal Behavior Manipulation

graph-based world model nullspace projections reactive control multi-objective tasks planar pushing

简要说明：一种基于图世界模型的零空间投影反应控制方法在多目标行为中实现非凸障碍导航和平面推操作，成功率达100%，并迁移至真实机器人。

TLDR: A reactive control method using nullspace projections on a graph-based world model achieves multi-objective behavior, demonstrated in navigation and planar pushing tasks with 100% success on non-convex objects, and transfers to a real robot.

Abstract: Reactive control is often considered insufficient for multi-objective tasks because conflicting objectives give rise to local minima. We argue this limitation is not inherent but arises from static encodings that fail to reflect how objectives currently interact. We exploit the interaction structure encoded in a graph-based world model by extending it with nullspace projections: conflicts are resolved where they arise by projecting lower-priority gradients into the nullspace of higher-priority ones, with priorities determined continuously from the current state. We demonstrate this in two domains where conflicts between objectives are central: navigation around non-convex obstacles, where static potential fields fundamentally fail, and planar pushing of non-convex objects, where our method achieves $100\%$ success across one-hundred configurations versus $0\%$ for the steepest-descent baseline and ${\sim}55\%$ for diffusion policy, without demonstrations or retraining. The same formulation transfers directly to a real robot with additional perceptual and kinematic constraints, accommodating them through the same mechanism.

摘要（中文）：反应式控制通常被认为不足以应对多目标任务，因为冲突的目标会导致局部极小值。我们认为这一局限性并非固有缺陷，而是源于无法反映目标当前交互方式的静态编码。我们通过将零空间投影引入基于图的世界模型来利用其中编码的交互结构：将低优先级梯度投影到高优先级梯度的零空间中，从而在冲突发生处解决冲突，且优先级根据当前状态连续确定。我们在两个目标间冲突为核心挑战的领域中验证了该方法：围绕非凸障碍物的导航（静态势场在此根本上失效）以及非凸物体的平面推动任务——在无需示范数据或重新训练的条件下，我们的方法在百种配置中实现100%的成功率，而最速下降基线为0%，扩散策略约为55%。同一框架可直接迁移至具备额外感知与运动学约束的真实机器人，通过相同机制兼容这些约束。

Authors: Vito Mengers, Oliver Brock

Learning to Balance Motor Thermal Safety and Quadrupedal Locomotion Performance with Residual Policy RLRobot

motor thermal management residual policy quadruped locomotion reinforcement learning Unitree A1

简要说明：本文提出了一种集成热模型的两阶段强化学习框架，用于平衡四足机器人电机热安全与运动性能，并在Unitree A1负载条件下验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a two-stage reinforcement learning framework with an integrated thermal model to balance motor thermal safety and locomotion performance in quadruped robots, validated on a Unitree A1 under payload.

Abstract: Motor thermal management is often overlooked in the context of electrically-actuated robots, particularly legged robots, but motor overheating is a key factor that limits long-duration locomotion especially under payload conditions. This paper integrates a whole-body thermal model of a quadruped robot into the reinforcement learning pipeline to update motor temperatures, and proposes a two-stage training framework for motor thermal management. In this framework, a nominal policy is first pre-trained as a locomotion baseline capable of traversing diverse terrains. A residual policy is then trained on top of the nominal policy to provide corrective actions based on the robot's thermal state, ensuring high performance under low-temperature conditions and preventing motor overheating under high-temperature conditions. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed policy achieves an effective balance between motor thermal safety and locomotion performance. Real-world experiments on a Unitree A1 quadruped robot further validate the approach: under a 3 kg payload, the robot achieves stable locomotion across multiple terrains for over 13 minutes, while the nominal policy alone leads to motor overheating in about 5 minutes.

摘要（中文）：在电机驱动型机器人（尤其是腿足机器人）中，电机热管理常被忽视，但电机过热是限制其长时间运动的关键因素，尤其在负载条件下。本文将四足机器人的全身热模型集成到强化学习流程中，以实时更新电机温度，并提出一种用于电机热管理的两阶段训练框架。在该框架中，首先预训练一个标称策略作为运动基线，使其能够穿越多种地形；随后在标称策略之上训练一个残差策略，根据机器人的热状态提供修正动作，从而确保低温条件下的高性能并防止高温条件下的电机过热。仿真结果表明，所提策略在电机热安全与运动性能之间实现了有效平衡。在宇树A1四足机器人上的实际实验进一步验证了该方法：在3千克负载下，机器人能在多种地形上稳定运动超过13分钟，而单独使用标称策略时，约5分钟即导致电机过热。

Authors: Yuhang Wan, Weixian Lin, Letian Qian, Yiqi Zou, Weiwei Wu, Shengwei Wu, Chuanlin Zhao, Xin Luo

Look Further: Socially-Compliant Navigation System in Residential Buildings VLN

social navigation proactive lane-changing human-robot interaction mobile delivery robot hallway navigation

简要说明：本文提出了一种主动变道运动模式，用于走廊环境中的移动送货机器人，将反应距离延长至8米以上，通过用户研究验证了其在安全性、流畅性和礼貌性方面的提升。

TLDR: This paper proposes a Proactive Lane-Changing (PLC) motion pattern for mobile delivery robots in hallways, extending reaction distance to over eight meters to improve perceived safety, smoothness, and politeness, validated by a user study.

Abstract: The distance at which a mobile robot reacts to a person strongly impacts various qualities of the human-robot interaction. In this paper, we focus on the navigation of a mobile delivery robot platform in a residential indoor hallway environment. Social navigation methods typically focus on avoiding uncomfortable human-robot interactions, such as when a robot encroaches on someone's personal space. Since personal space has been shown to be in the range of just a few meters, social navigation methods typically focus on deconflicting and resolving these short-range interactions. In this work, however, we demonstrate that by extending the reaction distance to over eight meters, far beyond the typical interaction distance, we can improve the human's perception of the robot's motion. We introduce the Proactive Lane-Changing (PLC) motion pattern and a navigation system that leverages it to react to people at an increased distance. This pattern consists of changing the robot's lateral position as it navigates down the hallway from the center to the side at an eight-meter distance from an oncoming person. We conducted a user study with 42 participants to assess their impressions of the delivery robot based on three service objectives: safety, smoothness, and politeness. In the straight hallway scenario (Frontal Approach), results showed significant improvement in each of these three objectives compared to typical motion patterns found in the literature: slowing down, stopping, and reactive collision avoidance in the proximity of a person. In contrast, in the intersection (Blind Corner) scenarios, none of the approaches performed significantly better than any other, with participants having a diverse range of preferences among robot motion patterns.

摘要（中文）：移动机器人对人类的反应距离会显著影响人机交互的多种质量指标。本文聚焦于移动送物机器人在住宅室内走廊环境中的导航问题。社交导航方法通常着重避免令人不适的人机交互，例如机器人侵入他人个人空间的情况。由于研究表明个人空间范围仅为几米，社交导航方法通常致力于消解和处理这类短距离交互。然而，本研究表明，将反应距离扩展至八米以上——远超典型交互距离——能够改善人类对机器人运动的感知。我们提出了主动变道运动模式及相应的导航系统，利用该模式在增大的距离上对行人做出反应。该模式表现为：机器人在走廊中央向侧面调整横向位置，在与迎面行人相距八米处完成车道变换。 我们开展了一项包含42名参与者的用户研究，基于安全性、流畅性和礼貌性三个服务目标评估其对送物机器人的印象。在直走廊场景（正面接近）中，相较于文献中典型的运动模式（减速、停车及近距离反应式避碰），该模式在上述三个目标上均展现出显著改善。而在交叉路口场景（盲角）中，所有方法的表现均无显著差异，参与者对不同机器人运动模式展现出多样化的偏好。

Authors: Akira Shiba, Marina Obata, Nathan Kau, Zoltan Beck, Rishi Shah, Michael Sudano, Sabrina Lee

On the Generalization Capabilities, Design Choices and Limitations of Keypoint Imitation Learning Manipulation

keypoint imitation learning robotic manipulation visual foundation models generalization data-efficient robot learning

简要说明：本文系统评估了关键点模仿学习（KIL）在机器人操作中的设计选择和泛化能力，表明KIL优于RGB基线但未超越S2-diffusion等替代表示。

TLDR: This paper systematically evaluates design choices and generalization capabilities of keypoint imitation learning (KIL) for robotic manipulation, showing KIL outperforms RGB baselines but does not surpass alternative representations like S2-diffusion.

Abstract: RGB-based imitation learning requires many demonstrations to generalize to unseen objects or scenes, motivating research into intermediate representations to improve generalization for robotic manipulation. Visual foundation models enable one-shot extraction of keypoints to provide such representation. However, it remains unclear how to integrate them into imitation learning optimally and when they outperform alternative representations. We combine approaches from previous works on keypoint imitation learning (KIL) and investigate several design choices to provide practical guidelines. Using over 2000 real-world rollouts, we also assess the generalization capabilities of KIL to unseen objects and scene variations. KIL achieves a 75% overall success rate across five tasks, significantly outperforming the RGB baseline (47%) and performing on par with S2-diffusion (73%). Finally, we explore the limitations of the foundation models used for keypoint extraction and extend KIL to tasks with multiple object instances. Our results confirm KIL as a data-efficient approach for robot learning, though it does not outperform alternative representations and inherits limitations of the foundation models used for keypoint extraction. All rollout videos, demonstrations, and results are available at https://kil-manipulation.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：基于RGB的模仿学习需要大量演示才能泛化到未见物体或场景，这促使研究者探索中间表示以提升机器人操作的泛化能力。视觉基础模型能够通过单次提取关键点来提供此类表示，然而如何将其最优地融入模仿学习、以及何时它们能超越替代表示仍不明确。我们结合了前人关于关键点模仿学习（KIL）的方法，并研究了若干设计选择以提供实用指南。通过超过2000次真实世界 rollout 实验，我们还评估了KIL对未见物体及场景变化的泛化能力。在五个任务中，KIL实现了75%的总体成功率，显著优于RGB基线（47%），且与S2-diffusion（73%）表现相当。最后，我们探索了用于关键点提取的基础模型的局限性，并将KIL扩展至包含多物体实例的任务。我们的结果证实KIL是一种数据高效的机器人学习方法，尽管其并未超越替代表示，并且继承了用于关键点提取的基础模型的局限性。所有 rollout 视频、演示及结果均可在 https://kil-manipulation.github.io/ 获取。

Authors: Thomas Lips, Marco Moletta, Michael C. Welle, Danica Kragic, Francis wyffels

Provably Safe Motion Planning Under Unknown Disturbances RLRobot

motion planning chance-constraints Wasserstein ambiguity tube sampling-based planning probabilistic completeness

简要说明：本文提出了一种在未知扰动下具有可证明安全性的基于采样的运动规划算法，利用数据驱动的Wasserstein模糊管来确保机会约束满足。

TLDR: This paper proposes a provably safe sampling-based motion planning algorithm for robotic systems under unknown disturbances, using data-driven Wasserstein ambiguity tubes to ensure chance-constraint satisfaction.

Abstract: We present a provably safe sampling-based motion planning algorithm for robotic systems affected by random disturbances of unknown distribution. We consider systems with linear or linearizable dynamics evolving in workspace with arbitrary-shaped obstacles subject to state and control constraints. Safety requirements are formulated as chance-constraints. Our approach leverages data from trajectories of the system to learn a Wasserstein ambiguity tube, i.e., a sequence of ambiguity sets, which contains the trajectory of the system's state distribution with high confidence. This ambiguity tube is then used in a probabilistically complete algorithm to grow a sampling-based motion planning tree that respects the constraints of the problem. We show that learning several lower-dimensional ambiguity tubes instead of a single high-dimensional one effectively reduces the conservatism and boosts scalability. Additionally, we design an efficient bandit-based validity checker that remarkably increases the empirical performance of our approach without sacrificing probabilistic completeness. Case studies show our algorithm finds valid plans in cluttered environments under strict safety thresholds, outperforming state-of-the-art methods.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了一种可证明安全的、基于采样的运动规划算法，适用于受未知分布随机扰动影响的机器人系统。我们考虑具有线性或可线性化动力学特性的系统，其工作空间中存在任意形状障碍物，并受到状态与控制约束。安全需求被表述为机会约束。该方法利用系统轨迹数据学习一个Wasserstein模糊管，即一系列模糊集，该模糊管以高置信度包含系统状态分布的轨迹。随后，该模糊管被用于一个概率完备算法中，以构建一棵满足问题约束的、基于采样的运动规划树。我们证明，学习多个低维模糊管而非单个高维模糊管，能够有效降低保守性并提升可扩展性。此外，我们设计了一种高效的基于摇臂的效验器，在不牺牲概率完备性的前提下显著提升了本方法的实证性能。案例研究表明，在严格安全阈值下，我们的算法能够在杂乱环境中找到有效规划，性能优于现有最先进方法。

Authors: Ibon Gracia, Qi Heng Ho, Luca Laurenti, Morteza Lahijanian

Efficient On-policy Visual-RL via Stochastic Decoupled Policy Gradient RLRobot

visual reinforcement learning policy gradient sim-to-real dexterous manipulation locomotion

简要说明：本文提出SDPG，一种轻量级视觉强化学习方法，通过随机扰动估计策略梯度，在单GPU上数小时内高效端到端训练视觉运动控制策略，并展示了仿真到真实的迁移。

TLDR: This paper introduces SDPG, a lightweight visual RL method that uses stochastic perturbations to estimate policy gradients, enabling efficient end-to-end training of visuomotor control policies on a single GPU within hours, with demonstrated sim-to-real transfer.

Abstract: We present the stochastic decoupled policy gradient (SDPG), a lightweight visual reinforcement learning (RL) method that trains diverse visuomotor control policies end-to-end within a few hours on a single NVIDIA RTX 4080 GPU. SDPG estimates policy gradients via random perturbations of trajectory rollouts, requiring orders of magnitude fewer batch-rendered environments and substantially reducing compute and memory overhead. On visual MuJoCo benchmarks, SDPG consistently outperforms baseline methods in training time, memory usage, and rewards. Finally, to support future research, we introduce a suite of realistic visual robotics benchmarks spanning dexterous manipulation, challenging locomotion, and demonstrate effective sim-to-real transfer on physical hardware.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了随机解耦策略梯度（SDPG），这是一种轻量级视觉强化学习方法，能够在单个NVIDIA RTX 4080 GPU上数小时内端到端地训练多样化的视觉运动控制策略。SDPG通过轨迹推演的随机扰动来估计策略梯度，所需批量渲染环境数量减少数个数量级，从而大幅降低计算与内存开销。在视觉MuJoCo基准测试中，SDPG在训练时间、内存使用和奖励值方面均持续优于基线方法。最后，为支持未来研究，我们推出了一套涵盖灵巧操作、高难度运动控制的逼真视觉机器人基准测试套件，并在实体硬件上展示了有效的仿真到现实迁移能力。

Authors: Haoxiang You, Yilang Liu, Davis Zong, Qian Wang, Teeratham Vitchutripop, Qi Wang, Daniel Rakita, Ian Abraham

Robust Koopman Control Barrier Filters for Safe Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

Koopman predictor control barrier functions safety filter actor-critic model-free RL

简要说明：该论文提出了一种安全过滤的演员-评论家强化学习框架，通过学习Koopman预测器构建仿射CBF约束来保证安全控制，并利用投影残差边界增强对近似误差的鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper proposes a safety-filtered actor-critic RL framework that learns a Koopman predictor from data to construct affine CBF constraints for safe control, with robustness to approximation errors via a projected residual margin.

Abstract: Safe reinforcement learning (RL) for robotic systems requires policies that improve task performance while satisfying state and input constraints during both training and deployment. Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide a principled mechanism for enforcing forward invariance through minimally invasive safety filters, but their use in model-free RL is limited by the need for accurate dynamics and hand-designed barrier certificates. We propose Robust Koopman-CBF SAC, a safety-filtered actor--critic framework that learns a finite-dimensional Koopman predictor from data, constructs affine CBF constraints in the lifted space, and enforces them through a quadratic-program safety layer. To account for finite-dimensional Koopman approximation error, the CBF condition is tightened using a projected residual margin estimated from held-out rollout data. The critic is trained on the executed safe action, while the actor is regularized toward the Koopman-CBF feasible set, reducing dependence on the filter over training. Across safe-control benchmarks, the method achieves zero constraint violations on CartPole stabilization and tracking while matching or exceeding unconstrained SAC returns. On high-dimensional Safety Gymnasium locomotion tasks, the method reduces violations in some settings but also exposes important limitations of first-order velocity barriers and linear EDMD models, motivating high-order and multi-step Koopman-CBF extensions. These results suggest that robust Koopman-CBF filters are a promising bridge between model-free RL and certifiable safety, while clarifying the structural conditions under which such filters remain effective. All code is available at \href{https://github.com/DhruvKushwaha/Koopman-CBF-Soft-Actor-Critic}{Github Repository}.

摘要（中文）：面向机器人系统的安全强化学习要求策略在训练与部署阶段既能提升任务性能，又满足状态与输入约束。控制障碍函数通过最小侵入式安全过滤器强制执行前向不变性，提供了严谨的机制，但其在无模型强化学习中的应用受限于对精确动力学和人工设计障碍证书的需求。我们提出鲁棒Koopman-CBF SAC框架——一种安全过滤的演员-评论家架构：从数据中学习有限维Koopman预测器，在升维空间中构建仿射CBF约束，并通过二次规划安全层强制执行。为补偿有限维Koopman近似误差，利用保留轨迹数据中估计的投影残差裕度收紧CBF条件。评论家基于执行的安全动作进行训练，演员则朝向Koopman-CBF可行集正则化，从而降低训练过程中对过滤器的依赖。在安全控制基准测试中，该方法在CartPole稳定与跟踪任务中实现零约束违反，同时达到或超越无约束SAC的回报。针对高维Safety Gymnasium运动任务，该方法虽在某些场景下减少了违规次数，但也暴露出一阶速度屏障与线性EDMD模型的重要局限性，由此推动了高阶与多步Koopman-CBF扩展研究。这些结果表明，鲁棒Koopman-CBF过滤器是无模型强化学习与可验证安全之间的有前景桥梁，同时阐明了此类过滤器保持有效性的结构条件。所有代码开源见Github仓库。

Authors: Dhruv S. Kushwaha, Zoleikha A. Biron

Multi-Robot Box Transport over Different Surfaces with Decentralized Role-based Proportional Control Manipulation

decentralized task and motion planning multi-robot transport role-based control proportional control NVIDIA IsaacSim

简要说明：本文提出R2P2，一种基于角色的去中心化控制方法，用于多机器人协作搬运箱子，可在不同倾斜度和摩擦力的表面工作，并在仿真和真实机器人上验证。

TLDR: This paper presents R2P2, a decentralized role-based control method for multi-robot box transport over varied surfaces, validated in simulation and on real robots.

Abstract: Collaborative transport of objects via pushing by multiple robots has many applications, ranging from construction and warehouse environments to post disaster debris clean-up. Achieving collaborative transport over surfaces with different inclination and friction properties however poses unique challenges. To address these challenges, this paper presents an asynchronous decentralized task and motion planning approach for transporting rectangular boxes of varying mass over flat, uphill and downhill terrain. Such a decentralized approach alleviates communication, synchronization and consensus needs and mitigates single point of failure issues. Our approach, called R2P2 or Roles with Rules and Proportional-control Primitive, assigns roles (e.g., push, support and prevent) to robots based on rules cognizant of the mode of manipulation needed (box rotation vs translation); this is followed by either rule-based control or proportional control of robot velocity based on the roles. Each robot is assumed to observe the location and heading of self and the box in executing the role and controls. R2P2 is evaluated with a six-robot team deployed in a simulator built using NVIDIA IsaacSim -- demonstrating generalizability across different surface friction/inclination and box mass scenarios, and better success rate compared to a standard virtual-leader-follower method. R2P2 is also successfully validated with a physical experiment, where it is executed onboard four turtlebots tasked with moving a 1.2 kg box.

摘要（中文）：通过多机器人协作推动物体在建筑、仓库环境及灾后 debris 清理等场景中具有广泛应用。然而，在具有不同倾斜度和摩擦特性的表面上实现协作搬运带来了独特挑战。针对这些问题，本文提出一种异步分散式任务与运动规划方法，用于在平坦、上坡及下坡地形中搬运质量各异的矩形箱体。该分散式方法降低了通信、同步与协商需求，并缓解了单点故障问题。本方法名为 R2P2（基于规则与比例控制原语的角色分配），首先根据所需操作模式（箱体旋转 vs 平移）感知的规则为机器人分配角色（如推动、支撑与阻挡）；随后基于角色执行基于规则的控制或比例速度控制。每个机器人在执行角色与控制时，需观测自身及箱体的位置与朝向。R2P2 在基于 NVIDIA IsaacSim 构建的模拟器中通过六机器人团队进行了评估——实验表明该方法在不同表面摩擦/倾斜度及箱体质量场景下具有泛化能力，且成功率优于标准虚拟领航-跟随方法。R2P2 还通过物理实验成功验证：在四台 TurtleBot 机器人上部署该方法，完成了 1.2 kg 箱体的移动任务。

Authors: Aditya Bhatt, Himavarshini Yarragangu, Urvish Shah, Venkata Sai Yaswanth Mohan Thota, Souma Chowdhury

RCSP: Risk-Sensitive Conjectural Scenario Planning for Safe Dynamic Robot Navigation RLRobot

risk-sensitive planning conjectural scenario dynamic navigation near-miss failure local safety check

简要说明：RCSP提出了一种风险敏感的规划层，通过评估候选指令对短期障碍物未来可能性的影响，避免动态瓶颈环境中的预测性近碰撞失误，在MuJoCo和ROS2/Gazebo仿真中进行了验证。

TLDR: RCSP introduces a risk-sensitive planning layer that evaluates robot commands against plausible short-horizon obstacle futures to avoid predictive near-miss collisions in dynamic bottleneck environments, demonstrated in simulation with MuJoCo and ROS2/Gazebo.

Abstract: Mobile robots can fail before they collide: a velocity that is safe now may commit the robot to a passage that moving obstacles will soon close. We study this predictive near-miss commitment problem and propose Risk-Sensitive Conjectural Scenario Planning (RCSP), a planning layer that evaluates candidate commands against plausible short-horizon obstacle futures. RCSP maintains a lightweight belief over local motion conjectures, samples future interactions, penalizes high-risk tails, and executes through a local safety check. In controlled MuJoCo bottleneck tasks, the RCSP planner reaches the goal without collisions and yields higher secondary safety and path-quality point estimates than a non-adaptive predictor, with additional latency. In ROS2/Gazebo, adding the local safety layer to a standard Nav2 stack reduces dynamic near-miss failures. On official DynaBARN/Jackal transfer, tuned DWA and TEB remain stronger on strict benchmark success, revealing the boundary of the approach. These simulation results position RCSP as a predictive-risk module that complements existing navigation stacks in dynamic bottleneck regimes.

摘要（中文）：移动机器人在碰撞前便可能失效：当前安全的运行速度可能使机器人陷入即将被移动障碍物封闭的通道。本研究针对此预测性近失碰撞承诺问题，提出风险敏感推断场景规划（RCSP）方法——一种通过评估候选指令在短期障碍物未来状态下的可行性进行规划的层级。RCSP维护对局部运动推断的轻量级信念，采样未来交互模式，惩罚高风险尾部事件，并通过局部安全检测执行控制。在受控的MuJoCo瓶颈任务中，RCSP规划器在无碰撞条件下达成目标，且相较于非自适应预测器获得更高的二次安全性与路径质量点估计值，但引入额外延迟。在ROS2/Gazebo环境中，向标准Nav2堆栈添加局部安全层可减少动态近失碰撞故障。在官方DynaBARN/Jackal迁移测试中，经调优的DWA与TEB在严格基准成功率上仍表现更优，揭示了该方法的边界条件。这些仿真结果将RCSP定位为动态瓶颈场景下可补充现有导航堆栈的预测性风险模块。

Authors: Zhengye Han, Quanyan Zhu

NightSight: Passive Computation for Navigation in Dark Using Events Perception3D

event camera coded aperture depth estimation autonomous navigation low-light perception

简要说明：本文提出了一种轻量化感知系统，结合事件相机、编码孔径镜头和红外点投影仪，使小型空中机器人在完全黑暗环境中实现密集深度估计和自主导航，仅使用合成数据训练。

TLDR: This paper presents a lightweight perception system for small aerial robots that combines an event camera, coded aperture lens, and infrared dot projector to enable dense depth estimation and autonomous navigation in complete darkness, using only synthetic data for training.

Abstract: Small aerial robots are particularly well-suited for search and rescue in confined and hazardous environments due to their agility, low cost, and ability to traverse through cluttered spaces that are inaccessible to larger platforms. However, enabling autonomous navigation in complete darkness remains a significant challenge, because small aerial robots cannot easily accommodate perception systems that demand substantial payload, power, or computation. In this work, we present a lightweight perception approach that combines a monocular event camera, a coded aperture lens, and an infrared dot projector to enable navigation in such conditions. The projected pattern, when imaged through the coded aperture, produces depth dependent blur signatures that implicitly encode scene geometry. We train a convolutional neural network to decode these signatures into dense depth maps using only synthetic data generated from a simple planar wall setup. Despite this minimal training regime, the model generalizes zero-shot to complex real-world scenes. Our system operates in real time at 20 Hz on a NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, demonstrating suitability for resource-constrained platforms. We further analyze the impact of different coded aperture designs on depth estimation performance. Our approach gives high accuracy (l1 error 7.0cm) upto 2.5m range (2.80% error). These results highlight the potential of combining structured illumination, coded optics, and event-based sensing for enabling robust perception and navigation in complete darkness.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 小型飞行机器人因其敏捷性、低成本以及能够穿越大型平台无法进入的杂乱空间，尤其适用于在受限和危险环境中执行搜索与救援任务。然而，在完全黑暗条件下实现自主导航仍是一项重大挑战，因为小型飞行机器人难以搭载需要较大载荷、功耗或计算资源的感知系统。在本文中，我们提出了一种轻量化感知方法，该方法结合了单目事件相机、编码孔径镜头和红外点阵投影器，使得在黑暗环境中导航成为可能。通过编码孔径成像后，投影图案会产生与深度相关的模糊特征，这些特征隐式编码了场景几何信息。我们训练了一个卷积神经网络，仅使用从简单平面墙壁装置生成的合成数据，即可将这些特征解码为稠密深度图。尽管训练条件极为简化，该模型仍能零样本泛化至复杂的真实场景。我们的系统在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上以20 Hz的频率实时运行，展示了其在资源受限平台上的适用性。我们进一步分析了不同编码孔径设计对深度估计性能的影响。该方法在2.5米范围内实现了高精度（L1误差7.0厘米，误差率2.80%）。这些结果凸显了结合结构光照明、编码光学和事件驱动感知在完全黑暗环境下实现稳健感知与导航的巨大潜力。

Authors: Deepak Singh, Brijan Vaghasiya, Shreyas Khobragade, Nitin Sanket

PhyPush: One Push is All You Need for Sensorless Physical Property Estimation with Physics-Guided Transformers Manipulation

physics-guided learning mass estimation friction estimation interactive perception Transformer

简要说明：PhyPush仅通过一次推动和运动学数据，利用物理引导损失估计物体的质量和摩擦系数，无需力/扭矩传感器。

TLDR: PhyPush estimates object mass and friction from a single push using only kinematic data, guided by physics-informed loss, eliminating the need for force/torque sensors.

Abstract: Accurately estimating object mass and friction is fundamental to achieving reliable and adaptive robotic manipulation. Although interactive perception provides a powerful mechanism for inferring such properties, most existing approaches depend on specialized hardware such as force/torque sensors, tactile arrays, or multi-camera motion-capture systems, limiting scalability and deployment. This paper presents PhyPush, a physics-guided Transformer framework that estimates an object's mass and friction coefficient using only kinematically derived end-effector velocity from a single push. This typically requires data available on standard robotic arms. The model incorporates constraints from Newton's second law and the Coulomb friction model through a physics-guided loss, improving physical consistency and generalization to unseen objects and surfaces. Across diverse simulation and real-world setups, PhyPush consistently achieves more accurate mass and friction estimation in challenging out-of-domain conditions. In simulation, it reduces error by over 10% compared with a baseline that has privileged access to full force information, while in real-world experiments, it outperforms a data-driven loss approach. Overall, the results demonstrate that physics-guided learning can enable low-cost, sensor-efficient estimation of physical properties, relying solely on a single push and readily available kinematic data.

摘要（中文）：准确估计物体的质量与摩擦系数是实现可靠且自适应机器人操作的基础。尽管交互感知为推断此类属性提供了有效机制，但现有方法大多依赖专用硬件，如力/力矩传感器、触觉阵列或多相机运动捕捉系统，这限制了系统的可扩展性与实际部署。本文提出PhyPush——一种基于物理引导的Transformer框架，仅通过单次推送中运动学推导的末端执行器速度即可估计物体质量与摩擦系数。该方法仅需标准机械臂通常可获取的数据。模型通过物理引导损失函数融入牛顿第二定律与库仑摩擦模型的约束，从而提升物理一致性及对未知物体与表面的泛化能力。在多种仿真与真实场景中，PhyPush在挑战性域外条件下持续实现更精准的质量与摩擦估计。仿真实验中，相比能够获取完整力信息的基线方法，其误差降低超过10%；真实实验中则优于基于数据驱动的损失方法。总体结果表明，物理引导学习能够仅依赖单次推送及易获取的运动学数据，实现低成本、高传感器效率的物理属性估计。

Authors: Koyo Fujii, Luis Figueredo, Praminda Caleb-Solly, Ivan Boschi, Edoardo Ida', Marco Carricato, Aly Magassouba

Uncertainty-Aware Gaussian Map for Vision-Language Navigation VLN

Semantic Gaussian Map perceptual uncertainty 3D Value Map geometric uncertainty Fisher Information

简要说明：本文针对视觉-语言导航中的感知不确定性，显式建模了几何、语义和外观三种不确定性，并构建统一的3D价值图来提升导航决策的鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper explicitly models geometric, semantic, and appearance uncertainty for Vision-Language Navigation (VLN), constructing a unified 3D Value Map from a Semantic Gaussian Map to enable more robust and informed navigation decisions.

Abstract: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an agent to navigate 3D environments following natural language instructions. During navigation, existing agents commonly encounter perceptual uncertainty, such as insufficient evidence for reliable grounding or ambiguity in interpreting spatial cues, yet they typically ignore such information when predicting actions. In this work, we explicitly model three forms of perceptual uncertainty (i.e., geometric, semantic, and appearance uncertainty) and integrate them into the agent's observation space to enable informed decision-making. Concretely, our agent first constructs a Semantic Gaussian Map (SGM), composed of differentiable 3D Gaussian primitives initialized from panoramic observations, that encodes both the geometric structure and semantic content of the environment. On top of SGM, geometric uncertainty is estimated through variational perturbations of Gaussian position and scale to assess structural reliability; semantic uncertainty is captured by perturbing Gaussian semantic attributes to reveal ambiguous interpretations; and appearance uncertainty is characterized by Fisher Information, which measures the sensitivity of rendered observations to Gaussian-level variations. These uncertainties are incorporated into SGM, extending it into a unified 3D Value Map, which grounds them as affordances and constraints that support reliable navigation. Comprehensive evaluations across multiple VLN benchmarks show the effectiveness of our agent.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言导航（VLN）要求智能体依据自然语言指令在三维环境中进行导航。在导航过程中，现有智能体常面临感知不确定性，例如缺乏足够证据实现可靠定位，或对空间线索的解读存在歧义，然而它们在预测动作时通常忽略这类信息。本文明确建模了三种感知不确定性（即几何、语义和外观不确定性），并将其融入智能体的观测空间以支持知情决策。具体而言，我们的智能体首先构建语义高斯地图，该地图由全景观测初始化的可微三维高斯基元组成，同时编码环境的几何结构与语义内容。在语义高斯地图基础上，通过高斯位置和尺度的变分扰动估计几何不确定性，以评估结构可靠性；通过扰动高斯语义属性捕捉语义不确定性，以揭示歧义性解读；基于费希尔信息表征外观不确定性，该指标衡量渲染观测对高斯层级变化的敏感度。这些不确定性被融入语义高斯地图，扩展为统一的3D价值地图，将其作为支持可靠导航的可供性与约束条件进行落地。跨多个VLN基准的综合评估验证了我们智能体的有效性。

Authors: Jianzhe Gao, Rui Liu, Yuxuan Xu, Tongtong Cao, Yingxue Zhang, Zhanguang Zhang, Sida Peng, Yi Yang, Wenguan Wang

Sentinel: Embodied Cooperative Spatial Reasoning and Planning VLN

cooperative spatial reasoning multi-agent navigation embodied agents foundation models spatial navigation

简要说明：本文提出了Sentinel Challenge基准，用于测试分散式具身代理在城市规模户外环境中的协作空间智能，并提出了CoSaR框架，该框架结合基础模型的通信与规划能力和经典导航算法，使代理能够协作、推理并安全导航，避开动态巡逻的哨兵。

TLDR: This paper introduces Sentinel Challenge, a benchmark for cooperative spatial intelligence among decentralized embodied agents in city-scale outdoor environments, and proposes CoSaR, a framework that combines foundation models for communication and planning with classical navigation algorithms to enable agents to coordinate, reason, and navigate safely while avoiding dynamic patrolling sentinels.

Abstract: In this work, we study Cooperative Spatial Intelligence, the ability of decentralized embodied agents to coordinate effectively under dynamic environmental constraints across city-scale outdoor domains. We introduce Sentinel Challenge, a benchmark where multiple decentralized embodied agents must communicate in natural language to agree on a mutually safe and convenient meeting point within large, city-scale outdoor environments. Each agent must then navigate safely while avoiding dynamic sentinels patrolling the area, using a tool that provides coarse spatial information. To address this, we propose CoSaR (Cooperative Spatial Reasoning and Planning), a framework that bridges the high-level communication and planning abilities of foundation models with the precision of classical spatial navigation algorithms. CoSaR enables agents to exchange situational updates, reason over evolving spatial constraints, and collaboratively replan trajectories. Evaluated across 14 city-level scenes with 3-5 agents, CoSaR consistently leads to faster gathering, shorter path lengths, and improved safety. Our results demonstrate that integrating dynamic communication with spatial reasoning is essential for robust multi-agent cooperation. By formalizing this new setting and providing a scalable benchmark, we aim to build a foundation for advancing cooperative spatial intelligence in embodied multi-agent systems. Code and challenge are available at https://github.com/UMass-Embodied-AGI/Sentinel.

摘要（中文）：在本工作中，我们研究了协作空间智能——即分散式具身智能体在城市级户外领域的动态环境约束下有效协调的能力。我们提出了哨兵挑战（Sentinel Challenge）基准测试，其中多个分散式具身智能体必须通过自然语言进行交流，在大型城市级户外环境中就一个相互安全且便利的会合点达成共识。随后，每个智能体需借助提供粗略空间信息的工具，在避开巡逻动态哨兵的同时实现安全导航。为解决此问题，我们提出了CoSaR（协作空间推理与规划）框架，该框架将基础模型的高层通信与规划能力同经典空间导航算法的精确性相结合。CoSaR使智能体能够交换情境更新信息、推理不断演变的空间约束，并协同重新规划轨迹。在包含3-5个智能体的14个城市级场景中进行的评估表明，CoSaR始终能实现更快的聚集速度、更短的路径长度以及更高的安全性。我们的结果证明，将动态通信与空间推理相融合对于实现稳健的多智能体协作至关重要。通过形式化这一新场景并提供可扩展的基准测试，我们旨在为推进具身多智能体系统中的协作空间智能奠定基础。代码与挑战详见https://github.com/UMass-Embodied-AGI/Sentinel。

Authors: Xiangye Lin, Hongxin Zhang, Ruxi Deng, Qinhong Zhou, Chuang Gan

Adversarial Dual On-Policy Distillation from Expressive Flow-based Teacher RLRobot

flow matching on-policy distillation behavioral cloning adversarial learning robot control

简要说明：本文提出FA-OPD，一种对抗性双在线策略蒸馏方法，通过协同训练流匹配教师和轻量级MLP学生，利用学生轨迹中的奖励和动作信号，提升了从演示中学习机器人导航、操作和 locomotion 策略的效果。

TLDR: This paper proposes FA-OPD, an adversarial dual on-policy distillation method that co-trains a flow-matching teacher and a lightweight MLP student using both reward and action signals from student rollouts, improving policy learning from demonstrations in robot navigation, manipulation, and locomotion tasks.

Abstract: Learning from demonstrations in embodied control is often cast as behavioral cloning, and recent diffusion or flow-matching policies improve this paradigm by modeling multi-modal expert actions. Yet these methods remain offline supervised learners: the policy is trained only on expert states and receives no corrective signal on the states it actually visits. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a natural remedy, but standard OPD assumes a strong fixed teacher, which is unavailable in demonstration-only control. We propose \textbf{FA-OPD}, an \emph{adversarial dual on-policy distillation} method in which a Flow Matching (FM) teacher is learned from demonstrations and co-trained with a lightweight MLP student. The teacher provides two complementary signals on student rollouts. The reward channel learns an expert-likeness objective over state-action pairs and drives online exploration through long-horizon policy optimization. The action channel supplies dense local targets at student-visited states, stabilizing exploitation. FA-OPD couples them so that reward distillation enables generalization beyond point-wise demonstrations, while action distillation keeps exploration anchored near expert-like behavior. Across six robot navigation, manipulation, and locomotion benchmarks, FA-OPD beats strong baselines and shows much stronger robustness under noisy or limited demonstrations.

摘要（中文）：在具身控制中，从示范中学习通常被构建为行为克隆，而最近的扩散或流匹配策略通过建模多模态专家行为改进了这一范式。然而，这些方法仍属于离线监督学习：策略仅在专家状态上训练，且在其实际访问的状态上未收到任何修正信号。在策略蒸馏（OPD）提供了一种自然补救措施，但标准OPD假设存在一个固定的强教师，而这在仅依赖示范的控制中不可用。我们提出**FA-OPD**，一种*对抗性双策略在策略蒸馏*方法，其中从示范中学习流匹配（FM）教师，并与轻量级MLP学生共同训练。该教师为学生 rollout 提供两种互补信号。奖励通道学习状态-动作对上的专家相似性目标，并通过长视野策略优化驱动在线探索。动作通道在学生访问的状态上提供密集的局部目标，从而稳定利用。FA-OPD将两者耦合，使得奖励蒸馏能够实现超越逐点示范的泛化，而动作蒸馏则将探索锚定在接近专家行为的状态附近。在六个机器人导航、操作和移动基准测试中，FA-OPD超越了强基线，并在噪声或有限示范条件下展现出更强的鲁棒性。

Authors: Zhenglin Wan, Jingxuan Wu, Xingrui Yu, Chubin Zhang, Mingcong Lei, Bo An, Ivor W. Tsang, Yang You

When Does LeJEPA Learn a World Model? WorldModel

linear identifiability world model Gaussian regularization latent-space planning LeJEPA

简要说明：本文证明LeJEPA在高斯假设下实现了世界潜在变量的线性可识别性，为用于机器人学和控制的世界模型提供了理论基础。

TLDR: This paper proves that LeJEPA achieves linear identifiability of world latent variables under Gaussian assumptions, providing a theoretical foundation for world models used in robotics and control.

Abstract: A representation that scrambles the true degrees of freedom of the world cannot support reliable planning or compositional generalization. We prove that LeJEPA (alignment plus Gaussian regularization) linearly recovers the world's latent variables from nonlinear observations, a property known as linear identifiability, in a broad class of worlds where latents evolve under stationary, additive-noise transitions. Our main result is that among all such worlds, the Gaussian is the unique latent distribution for which this guarantee holds. The forward direction rests on a spectral decomposition in which each degree of nonlinearity is strictly penalized by alignment, making the linear map the optimum; the converse rules out every non-Gaussian alternative. We further prove an approximate identifiability result where the guarantee degrades gracefully, and show that linear, orthogonal identifiability enables optimal latent-space planning. We validate the theory with experiments ranging from 2D examples to 1024-dimensional latents, including distributional ablations and pixel-based robotic control. Our theory turns an empirically successful recipe into a mathematical guarantee, providing the foundation for building World Models that provably recover the structure of the world.

摘要（中文）：一种打乱世界真实自由度的表征无法支持可靠的规划或组合泛化。我们证明，在潜在变量遵循平稳加性噪声演化的广泛世界中，LeJEPA（对齐加高斯正则化）能够从非线性观测中线性恢复世界的潜在变量，这一性质被称为线性可识别性。我们的主要结论是：在所有此类世界中，高斯分布是唯一能使该保证成立的潜在分布。正向推导依赖于谱分解，其中每个非线性度都受到对齐的严格惩罚，从而使线性映射成为最优；反之则排除了所有非高斯替代方案。我们进一步证明了近似可识别性结果，其中保证会优雅地退化，并表明线性正交可识别性能够实现最优潜在空间规划。我们通过从二维示例到1024维潜在变量的实验验证了该理论，包括分布消融实验和基于像素的机器人控制。我们的理论将经验上成功的配方转化为数学保证，为构建能够可证明恢复世界结构的世界模型奠定了基础。

Authors: David Klindt, Yann LeCun, Randall Balestriero

YOLO26-RipeLoc Lite: A lightweight architecture for tomato ripeness detection and picking point localization in greenhouse robotic harvesting Manipulation

tomato ripeness detection picking point localization lightweight deep learning robotic harvesting

简要说明：提出一种基于YOLO的轻量级架构，用于温室机器人采摘中的番茄成熟度检测、分类和采摘点定位。

TLDR: Proposes a lightweight YOLO-based architecture for simultaneous tomato ripeness detection, classification, and picking-point localization in greenhouse robotic harvesting.

Abstract: In greenhouse tomato production, automated harvesting requires accurate detection of ripe tomatoes, ripeness classification, and precise picking-point localization for robotic end-effectors. This paper proposes YOLO26-RipeLoc Lite, a lightweight deep learning architecture based on YOLO26 for simultaneous detection, ripeness classification, and center-point localization of greenhouse tomatoes. The model introduces three modifications: (1) a Lightweight Feature Pyramid Network (LFPN) with depthwise separable convolutions for efficient multi-scale fusion, (2) a Ripeness-Aware Attention Module (RAAM) with dual pooling and a learnable ripeness bias vector for enhanced color-texture discrimination, and (3) a Compact Detection Head (CDH) with shared convolutions and an integrated center-point regression branch for direct grasp planning. The model is evaluated on a custom dataset of 1,500 images with 6,227 instances (3,566 ripe, 2,661 unripe) from the SILAL greenhouse, Abu Dhabi, UAE. YOLO26-RipeLoc Lite achieves mAP@0.5 of 92.9% (95.2% ripe, 90.6% unripe) with the highest precision (95.2%) among all evaluated architectures using only 2.38M parameters. Post-training BatchNorm pruning at 30% reduces parameters to ~1.8M with negligible accuracy loss. Ablation studies confirm that greenhouse-aware HSV augmentation provides the largest improvement (+2.02 pp mAP@50), backbone freezing achieves peak precision (93.8%), and 3-phase progressive unfreezing yields the best localization quality (mAP@50:95 of 64.6%). Comparisons with YOLOv8n/s, YOLO11n/s, YOLO12n/s, and YOLO26s confirm superior accuracy-efficiency: 2.9 pp higher precision than YOLO12n with 7.0% fewer parameters and integrated center-point localization for robotic end-effector guidance.

摘要（中文）：在温室番茄生产中，自动化采摘需要准确检测成熟番茄、进行成熟度分类，并为机器人末端执行器精确定位采摘点。本文提出YOLO26-RipeLoc Lite，一种基于YOLO26的轻量级深度学习架构，用于同步实现温室番茄的检测、成熟度分类及中心点定位。该模型引入三项改进： (1) 轻量级特征金字塔网络（LFPN），采用深度可分离卷积实现高效多尺度融合； (2) 成熟度感知注意力模块（RAAM），通过双池化结构和可学习的成熟度偏置向量增强颜色-纹理判别能力； (3) 紧凑检测头（CDH），采用共享卷积与集成中心点回归分支，可直接用于抓取规划。模型在来自阿联酋阿布扎比SILAL温室的定制数据集上进行评估，该数据集包含1500张图像、6227个实例（其中成熟番茄3566个，未成熟番茄2661个）。YOLO26-RipeLoc Lite在仅使用238万参数的条件下，实现mAP@0.5达92.9%（成熟番茄95.2%，未成熟番茄90.6%），在所有评估架构中取得最高精度（95.2%）。采用30%比例的批量归一化剪枝后，参数量降至约180万，精度损失可忽略不计。消融实验证实：温室感知HSV增强带来最大性能提升（mAP@50提高2.02个百分点），骨干网络冻结达到峰值精度（93.8%），三阶段渐进式解冻法取得最佳定位质量（mAP@50:95为64.6%）。与YOLOv8n/s、YOLO11n/s、YOLO12n/s及YOLO26s的对比验证了其优越的精度-效率平衡：相比YOLO12n精度提高2.9个百分点，参数量减少7.0%，并集成用于机器人末端执行器引导的中心点定位功能。

Authors: Rajmeet Singh, Manveen Kaur, Shahpour Alirezaee, Irfan Hussain

Trust, Geometry, and Rules: A Credibility-Aware Reinforcement Learning Framework for Safe USV Navigation under Uncertainty RLRobot

credibility-aware RL geometric safety shielding COLREGs compliance uncertainty estimation unmanned surface vehicles

简要说明：一种面向无人水面艇安全航行的可信感知强化学习框架，通过不确定性加权值学习、几何安全屏蔽和连续规则嵌入保障鲁棒性。

TLDR: A credibility-aware RL framework for safe USV navigation that combines uncertainty-weighted value learning, geometric shielding via covariances, and continuous COLREGs rule embedding.

Abstract: Autonomous navigation of Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USVs) that is safe and compliant with the International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea (COLREGs) remains a formidable challenge in dynamic maritime environments, particularly when perception systems exhibit miscalibrated uncertainty. Existing Reinforcement Learning (RL)-based methods often falter because state-estimation errors induce unreliable belief states that mislead the value function, while discrete traffic rules introduce discontinuity in the learning objective. To address these challenges, we propose a framework integrating credibility-aware learning, geometric safety shielding, and continuous rule-aware embedding. First, Credibility-Weighted Value Learning (CW-VL) introduces a dynamic trust factor derived from the discrepancy between filter-estimated covariance and empirical error statistics to modulate the critic's heteroscedastic loss, preventing policy overfitting to noisy samples. Second, the Covariance-Inflated Velocity Obstacle (CI-VO) maps position-estimation uncertainty into set-wise angular margins, forming a conservative geometric shield that overrides hazardous exploratory actions. Third, Risk-Aware COLREGs Duty Embedding relaxes binary encounter duties into continuous rule-aware signals, providing smooth sector-transition information and suppressing oscillation from sparse rule rewards. Simulated encounter studies demonstrate improved training robustness against perceptual inconsistency and superior collision avoidance and COLREGs compliance over baselines.

摘要（中文）：自主水面无人艇（USV）在动态海事环境中实现安全且符合《国际海上避碰规则》（COLREGs）的自主导航仍是一项严峻挑战，尤其在感知系统存在未标定不确定性时。现有基于强化学习（RL）的方法常因状态估计误差导致不可靠的信念状态误导值函数而失效，同时离散交通规则使学习目标产生不连续性。针对上述问题，我们提出了一种融合可信度感知学习、几何安全防护与连续规则感知嵌入的框架。首先，可信度加权值学习（CW-VL）通过滤波器估计协方差与经验误差统计量之间的差异构建动态信任因子，以调节评价器的异方差损失，防止策略对噪声样本过拟合。其次，协方差膨胀速度障碍（CI-VO）将位置估计不确定性映射为集合角裕度，形成保守几何防护层以覆盖危险探索动作。最后，风险感知COLREGs义务嵌入将二元会遇义务松弛为连续规则感知信号，提供平滑的扇区过渡信息并抑制稀疏规则奖励引发的振荡。仿真会遇研究结果表明，该方法在感知不一致场景下具有更强的训练鲁棒性，且在避碰性能与COLREGs符合性方面均优于基线方法。

Authors: Yuhang Zhang, Shuqi Chai, Yukang Zhang, Liusha Yang, Mingchuan Zhang, Wei Wang, Qingjiang Shi, Quanbo Ge

OSMa-Bench++: Toward Open-Ended Benchmarking of Semantic Mapping for Manipulation with Prompt-Generated Synthetic Scenes Perception3D

semantic mapping synthetic scene generation manipulation benchmarking VQA

简要说明：通过提示生成的合成室内场景扩展OSMa-Bench，实现对用于机器人操作的语义映射方法的可控压力测试基准评估。

TLDR: Extends OSMa-Bench with prompt-generated synthetic indoor scenes for controllable, stress-test benchmarking of semantic mapping methods used in robotic manipulation.

Abstract: Semantic mapping methods are increasingly used as intermediate scene representations for downstream robotic reasoning and manipulation, yet their evaluation is still largely tied to fixed benchmark datasets with limited coverage of manipulation-relevant corner cases. In this work, we extend OSMa-Bench toward controllable benchmarking with prompt-generated synthetic indoor scenes. Our pipeline automatically generates scene descriptions, synthesizes corresponding environments with SceneSmith, and adapts the resulting assets into an OSMa-Bench-compatible simulation format. This adaptation requires a nontrivial intermediate layer, including semantic normalization, material and texture repair, shader fallback policies, floor handling, navigation setup, and controlled lighting configuration. A key advantage of the proposed setup is that the original scene-generation prompt is known in advance and can therefore serve as an auxiliary semantic specification of the intended scene. We use this property to extend the VQA component of OSMa-Bench with a prompt-grounded question category. The resulting framework supports targeted stress-testing of semantic scene representations under conditions such as clutter, small objects, partial occlusions, and lighting variation, and makes benchmarking more extensible and better aligned with downstream manipulation requirements. Our code is available at https://github.com/be2rlab/OSMa-Bench-v2.

摘要（中文）：语义映射方法越来越多地被用作下游机器人推理与操作的中间场景表征，然而其评估仍主要依赖于覆盖范围有限的固定基准数据集，难以涵盖操作相关边界案例。为此，本研究将OSMa-Bench扩展为可通过提示生成的合成室内场景进行可控基准测试的框架。我们的流程可自动生成场景描述，借助SceneSmith合成相应环境，并将生成的资产适配为兼容OSMa-Bench的仿真格式。这一适配过程需要构建一个关键中间层，包括语义归一化、材质与纹理修复、着色器回退策略、地板处理、导航配置及受控光照设置。该方案的核心优势在于，原始场景生成提示可预先获知，因此能作为目标场景的辅助语义规范。我们利用这一特性，通过引入基于提示的问答类别来扩展OSMa-Bench的视觉问答组件。最终形成的框架支持在杂乱场景、小物体、局部遮挡及光照变化等条件下对语义场景表征进行针对性压力测试，使基准测试更具扩展性，并更好地契合下游操作任务需求。我们的代码已开源：https://github.com/be2rlab/OSMa-Bench-v2。

Authors: Regina Kurkova, Maxim Popov, Sergey Kolyubin

L-Learning : A Lyapunov-Based Approach Leveraging Lagrangian Mechanics for Efficient and Stable Robot Tracking RLRobot

Lyapunov stability Lagrangian mechanics trajectory tracking data-driven control sample efficiency

简要说明：本文提出L-Learning，一种将李雅普诺夫稳定性理论与拉格朗日力学相结合的数据驱动控制框架，用于实现机器人高效且稳定的轨迹跟踪。

TLDR: This paper proposes L-Learning, a data-driven control framework that integrates Lyapunov stability theory with Lagrangian mechanics to achieve efficient and stable trajectory tracking for robots.

Abstract: This paper presents L-Learning, a novel data-driven control framework for robotics that integrates Lyapunov stability theory with Lagrangian mechanics to enhance trajectory tracking performance. While traditional control methods often suffer from performance degradation in dynamic and uncertain environments, data-driven approaches, while more adaptable, are frequently limited by high sample complexity and a lack of rigorous stability guarantees. L-Learning mitigates these challenges by explicitly learning the system's energy function from data, thereby optimizing performance while ensuring closed-loop stability intrinsically. Characterized by superior control accuracy, theoretical stability guarantees, and high sample efficiency, L-Learning represents a promising solution for practical robotic applications.

摘要（中文）：**摘要：** 本文提出L-Learning，一种新颖的机器人数据驱动控制框架，该框架将李雅普诺夫稳定性理论与拉格朗日力学相结合，以提升轨迹跟踪性能。传统控制方法在动态和不确定环境中常出现性能退化，而数据驱动方法虽更具适应性，却往往受限于高样本复杂度与缺乏严格的稳定性保证。L-Learning通过从数据中显式学习系统的能量函数来缓解上述挑战，从而在优化性能的同时内在确保闭环稳定性。凭借优越的控制精度、理论上的稳定性保证以及高样本效率，L-Learning为实际机器人应用提供了一种颇具前景的解决方案。
